test_m3 = '''"""Tests for milestone m3: Remove duplicate code in Version.bump_build.

No source inspection allowed - verify behavior only.
Re-run all m2 assertions plus additional cases to confirm no regression after deduplication.
"""


def test_bump_build_non_numeric_last_segment():
    """Regression: non-numeric last segment still gets '.0' appended."""
    from semver.version import Version
    v = Version.parse('1.2.3+alpha')
    result = v.bump_build()
    assert str(result) == '1.2.3+alpha.0', f"Expected 1.2.3+alpha.0, got {result}"


def test_bump_build_numeric_last_segment_increments():
    """Regression: numeric last segment still increments normally."""
    from semver.version import Version
    v = Version.parse('1.2.3+build.9')
    result = v.bump_build()
    assert str(result) == '1.2.3+build.10', f"Expected 1.2.3+build.10, got {result}"


def test_bump_build_no_existing_build_creates_default():
    """When there is no existing build metadata, bump_build creates 'build.1' from default token."""
    from semver.version import Version
    v = Version.parse('1.2.3')
    result = v.bump_build()
    assert str(result) == '1.2.3+build.1', f"Expected 1.2.3+build.1, got {result}"


def test_bump_build_with_prerelease_and_numeric_build():
    """Regression: version with both prerelease and numeric build increments correctly."""
    from semver.version import Version
    v = Version.parse('3.4.5-rc.1+build.9')
    result = v.bump_build()
    assert str(result) == '3.4.5-rc.1+build.10', f"Expected 3.4.5-rc.1+build.10, got {result}"


def test_bump_build_preserves_prerelease():
    """bump_build must not alter the prerelease part of the version."""
    from semver.version import Version
    v = Version.parse('2.0.0-beta.3+custom.5')
    result = v.bump_build()
    assert result.prerelease == 'beta.3', f"Prerelease changed: expected beta.3, got {result.prerelease}"
    assert str(result) == '2.0.0-beta.3+custom.6', f"Expected 2.0.0-beta.3+custom.6, got {result}"
'''

with open('crucible_hidden/test_m3.py', 'w') as f:
    f.write(test_m3)
print("test_m3.py written")
